name: collab-notes
description: Real-time collaborative notes, whiteboards and task boards (React, Express, Yjs, WebSockets).

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
